meta.name: company-research
meta.description: Create a company research brief with executive quotes, product strategy, and org context. Use when preparing for interviews, competitive analysis, partnerships, or market-entry work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成公司调研简报，含高管引述与战略分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速了解一家公司的战略与背景
copy.tagline_en: Generate a company research brief with executive quotes and strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand a company's strategy and background

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成一份公司研究简报，包含高管引述、产品策略、组织动态等，用于面试准备、竞争分析、合作评估或市场进入决策。
howto.when: 当你提供公司名称和研究目的（如面试、竞争分析）时触发。也可以只给公司名，Claude 会先询问目的再生成简报。

say.text: 研究 Stripe 的产品策略，用于竞争分析。
say.note: Claude 会重点分析产品策略和竞争定位。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates a company research brief with executive quotes, product strategy, and organizational context, useful for interview prep, competitive analysis, partnership evaluation, or market entry decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a company name and research purpose (e.g., interview prep, competitive analysis). If only the company name is given, Claude asks for the purpose first.

say_en.text: Create a company research brief on Datadog — I interview with their platform PM team Friday.
say_en.note: Claude generates a brief with executive quotes, product strategy, etc.

say_en.text: Research Stripe's product strategy for competitive analysis.
say_en.note: Claude focuses on product strategy and competitive positioning.
